analysis.null: Exact source pixel-hash replay against unannotated inputs; no Owner quality inference before answers
analysis.primary: category/geometry agreement and ambiguity on unique reviewed events
analysis.quality_threshold: not invented; report numbers and Owner semantics decision before release
analysis.repeat: four-class raw agreement and Cohen kappa; constant-marginal kappa undefined; core and vertical errors among same-direction positive repeat pairs
analysis.scoring: reject foreign or duplicate IDs; drafts never count; no automatic label mutation

display.annotation: Owner chooses class, unrestricted core span, vertical box and box semantics; no model box prefill
display.available_clock: last visible 15m bar open + 15 minutes, not first-hit clock
display.pixels: exact original unannotated representative W18 model input

owner_authorization.scope: Prepare Owner calibration, independent-evaluation design and a controlled hard-negative replacement experiment; manual labels remain required.

sampling.cross_venue_exclusion: all existing positive and negative dependency intervals, either direction, train and val, plus 150 bars on both sides; literal symbol normalization, no guessed token aliases
sampling.purpose: training-era challenge calibration, not population precision/recall
sampling.selection: sha256(seed|sample|event_id); no score or return ranking
